title: Renewal sticky notes & QBR prep - NimbleRetail
body:
TODAY (2026-07-15) — quick scratchpad

Top priority: NimbleRetail renewal (enterprise) — 2026-08-10 renewal window.

Snapshot
- ARR on contract: $420k/year (confirm with AE Diego)
- Current usage: 68% of reserved capacity; spikes on batch scoring jobs at 02:00 UTC
- Major open support: CS-9874 (embedding drift after model swap), severity medium, owner: eng-support
- Exec sponsor: Claire Zhao (SVP Product), Champion: Samir Patel (ML lead)

QBR prep bullets to draft (30 min)
- Wins (3): reduced per-token cost by 22% after quantization pilot; average 95 ms P50 generation latency on dedicated pool; enabled prefix caching for catalog jobs saving ~12% token usage.
- Risks (3): embedding regression still in investigation (linked CS-9874), billing spike potential if batch windows not throttled, on-prem eval missing some telemetry.
- Asks (3): confirm renewed committed GPUs to avoid burst overage; set canary window for next model variant; AE to surface renewal discount band.

Quick meeting checklist (QBR draft call)
- Intro (5m): confirm agenda and outcomes (renewal decision + 1 pilot ask)
- Metrics (10m): latency/cost trend, top 3 incidents since last QBR, usage forecast for next 12 months
- Roadmap fit (7m): private deployment timeline, dedicated autoscale improvements, observability retention option
- Action items & next steps (8m)

Call-specific to-dos (today)
- [ ] Pull token-level cost report (last 90 days) — console -> Billing -> token-breakdown — assign to me (Aria) — due EOD 7/15
- [ ] Confirm ARR and any pending amendments with Diego (Slack DM) — tag: @diego — due 7/15
- [ ] Draft 1-page QBR slide w/ 3 charts (usage, latency, regressions) — start from previous deck (CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD/NIMBLERETAIL-QBR) — due 7/16 morning
- [ ] Ping eng-support for status on CS-9874 and ask for ETA on root cause — include logs subset (attach sample) — due 7/15 afternoon
- [ ] Pre-empt billing question: get list of top 10 callers by token usage last 30 days — request to billing-ops — due 7/16

Notes to self / talking points
- Emphasize that Dedicated + canary = low-risk model rollouts; mention fallback to hosted smaller model if spike. Keep it concrete: "we can pin v1.4 and fallback to v1.2 in <2m".
- For Claire: focus on platform SLAs and predictable cost; avoid deep infra details.
- For Samir (ML): show training-to-serving delta and KV cache benefits — ask if they want a short tech session w/ applied-ml.

Escalation flags
- If eng-support ETA > 5 business days -> escalate to SRE lead (Mina Patel) and loop Diego.
- If usage forecast > 120% of committed in next quarter -> propose temporary burst agreement and show cost delta.

Open questions to resolve before QBR
- Is there a pending PO amendment in procurement? (Priya to check)
- Which model versions are they using for catalog vs. interactive? (Samir to confirm)
- Any compliance docs needed for private deployment demo? (security checklist)

Follow-ups / micro-asks for AE / PM / Billing
- AE Diego: confirm discount band and negotiation levers, provide renewal timeline from legal (copy: priya).
- PM (console): can we surface a 90-day trend chart quickly in the QBR slide? (ask for PNG export)
- Billing Ops: export token-by-route CSV for top 50 routes (anonymize internal IDs)

End-of-day mini-retro (notes for tomorrow)
- What went well: quick data pull worked after small query tweak.
- Blockers: embedding regression still noisy, logs missing correlating trace ids.
- Next focus: finalize slide narrative, rehearse 10-minute QBR run, lock action owners.

Random reminders
- Keep QBR slide <=6 slides; leadership prefers concise.
- Bring up Optimize suggestions: recommend auto-batching policy for catalog jobs.
- Add a one-line win for the ML team: "reduced API error rate by 0.8% after routing fix"

Scratch thoughts (brain dump)
- Could propose a limited Proof-of-Concept for private deployment to reduce latency at EU sites — scope: 2 racks, 3-week install, show 30% latency reduction on p95.
- If procurement slow, propose short-term month-to-month bridge for extra capacity.

——
Personal TODO (non-customer)
- [ ] Sync with Priya re: legal doc status (7/16)
- [ ] Add formatted slide to Drive and send to Diego for review (7/16 morning)

End of note.

(Free-form — update after each call; keep this doc as the working truth for NimbleRetail QBR/renewal run.)
